svg.text: seal retention rib, thickness x height........3.0 x 10.0
latch panel prep holes........................2 x dia 7.8
striker slot, depth x end radius..............17.0 x 8.0
bushing bores, dia x pitch....................15.0 H7 at u = -170 / 230
1. ONE CNC program and ONE fixture for all four. Interchangeability is a manufacturing claim, not a design claim, and this is where it is made.
2. Bushing pair true position 0.05 to datum A-B.
4. Bushing bore is 10 G6, NOT H7: MISUMI offers H7 only at d = 2-6.
5. Seal rib 3.0 thick to sit inside the Trim-Lok DD6139 grip range 1.52-3.18.
6. Black anodise Type II after machining. Mask the bond flange.
NOT RELEASED FOR FABRICATION. Uncalibrated against the physical vehicle. No FEA performed.
